# linux_host (Data Source)

Facts about the host, like Ansible facts or Salt grains: operating system, kernel, architecture, resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "linux_host" "this" {}

# Install the right package for the distribution.
resource "linux_package" "web_server" {
  name = data.linux_host.this.os_id == "alpine" ? "nginx" : "nginx-light"
}

output "os" {
  value = "${data.linux_host.this.os_pretty_name} (${data.linux_host.this.architecture}, ${data.linux_host.this.cpu_count} CPUs)"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `architecture` (String) Machine architecture (`uname -m`), such as `x86_64` or `aarch64`.
- `cpu_count` (Number) Number of processors available.
- `hostname` (String) Host name.
- `id` (String) Machine ID, or host name when the host has none.
- `init_system` (String) `systemd`, or the name of the process 1.
- `kernel_release` (String) Kernel release (`uname -r`).
- `machine_id` (String) Content of `/etc/machine-id`.
- `memory_total` (Number) Total memory, in bytes.
- `os_id` (String) `ID` from `/etc/os-release`, such as `debian`, `ubuntu`, `rhel` or `alpine`.
- `os_id_like` (String) `ID_LIKE` from `/etc/os-release`: related distributions, such as `debian` for Ubuntu.
- `os_name` (String) `NAME` from `/etc/os-release`.
- `os_pretty_name` (String) `PRETTY_NAME` from `/etc/os-release`.
- `os_version_codename` (String) `VERSION_CODENAME` from `/etc/os-release`, such as `bookworm`.
- `os_version_id` (String) `VERSION_ID` from `/etc/os-release`, such as `12` or `24.04`.
- `package_manager` (String) Package manager used by `linux_package`: `apt`, `dnf`, `yum`, `zypper`, `apk`, `pacman`, or empty.
